spans.s:
त्रेता f. (-ता)
 1. The second Yuga or age of the Hindus, consisting of
1,296,000 years.
 2. The three sacred fires collectively, or the
southern, household, and sacrificial fires.
 E. त्र preservation, &c.
derived from त्रै to preserve, इत obtained, got.

त्रेताग्नि m. (-ग्निः) A man who has preserved the three sacred fires.
 E. त्रेता
as above, and अग्नि fire.

त्रेतायुग n. (-गं) The second or Treta age.
 E. त्रेता, and युग age.

त्रेधा ind. Triple, threefold, in three ways.
 E. त्रि three, धा affix, and ए
substituted for the vowel.
